Someday you'll see Ithor and say, 'I thought I'd seen jungles on&mdash;' what's the name of this planet, Commander?|Narra|This planet's so remote it doesn't even ''have'' a name, Senesca.|attr=Luke Skywalker, Wedge Antilles, Zev Senesca, and Arhul Narra|src=<ref name="E26">[[Empire 26|''Empire'' 26]]</ref>}}
'''Lubang Minor''' was a jungle planet widely considered nameless located in the [[Illisurevimurasi sector/Legends|Illisurevimurasi sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Lubang Minor was the site of a [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[Battle of Lubang Minor (Clone Wars)|battle]] that stranded [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Able|BL-1707]], known as Able. Decades later, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] attempted to site a [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] on the unsettled planet in a mission guarded by Rebel pilots [[Arhul Narra/Legends|Arhul Narra]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], and [[Zev Senesca/Legends|Zev Senesca]]. They were [[Battle of Lubang Minor (Galactic Civil War)|attacked]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces, which drove the Rebels off the world only after they had met and recruited Able.<ref name="GS" />
